name: Geiger Key Marina, RV Park & Fish Camp
note: A marina, fish-camp restaurant and tiki bar with a gravel RV lot on the seawall; 14 of its roughly 36 sites are sold by the night online. All sites are back-in, and the park rules say it is not set up for children. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site geigerkeymarina.com/rv-park (full hookups, phone 305-296-3553, Book Now) and its Rent Manager booking engine (bedg.booking.rentmanager.com, property 230, Settings + SiteGroups API) read 2026-10-30: 14 bring-your-own RV sites sold by the night (Inland Transient 10 at 30 ft, Waterfront 15-24 and 36 at 30-43 ft, Premium Waterfront 13-14 at 26-45 ft, 50-amp, Class A/B/C admitted), no minimum-nights rule (IsMinimumNightsAllowed false), single nights priced on Nov 17 and Dec 1 2026, Jan 12, Mar 9, Jun 8, Jul 13 and Sep 14 2027, and a 1-night checkout quote reached the deposit step with no application or approval; four park-owned RV rentals and two houses are also in the engine; Google Maps open at the pin, phone, 4.6/1,910; run by Parakeet Communities -> real transient RV park, not hurricane-closed; price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator sells 'Waterfront RV Sites' and 'Premium Waterfront RV Sites'; that only triggered the audit. Esri World Imagery (sat.py, all rendered and read: 1.8 km frame at 24.5818,-81.6482, 500 m frame at 24.5818,-81.6482, 220 m frame at 24.5814,-81.6474, 160 m frame at 24.58184,-81.64764) shows the south row of the lot backed in to a seawall on the south shore of Geiger Key, a tiki hut at each pad and the rear of each RV a few metres from the water, with no road, lot or treeline between. The water there is a dredged edge channel about 10-15 m wide; across it lie two mangrove islets, and through the ~30 m gap between them and along the whole east end the channel opens straight onto the open shallow seagrass flats of the Atlantic side, which run several hundred metres south to deeper water. So the waterfront row faces open flats across a narrow edge strip (the Bluewater Key case), not a canal with a built far bank. The north row backs onto a treeline along the road and is not on the water. Bayfront earned by the south (waterfront) row. Label settled 2026-10-30 (Claude, reviewing): defaulted down to creekside. The pads face the 10-15 m dredged channel, with mangrove islets across most of it and the open flats in view only through a ~30 m gap and at the east end, so under the canal size rule (narrower than ~30 m = creekside) the water at the sites is a narrow channel, not the bay.
fees_source: Rent Manager booking engine (bedg.bookingapi.rentmanager.com/Booking/SiteGroups?propertyID=230) read 2026-10-30, 2 adults, one night: in season (Tue Nov 17 2026, Tue Dec 1 2026, Tue Mar 9 2027) Inland Transient site 10 (30 ft) $180, Waterfront RV Sites $205, Premium Waterfront $225; summer (Tue Jun 8, Jul 13, Sep 14 2027) $160 / $175 / $195. Checkout quote, Nov 17-18 2026 site 10: $180.00 + taxes $22.50 = $202.50, 30% due at booking; no resort or grounds fee. A platform fee of 2.95% (credit) or $5.95 (debit) applies to card payments. Park-owned RV rentals ($275-450) are not sites and are excluded.
flags: Mix: the engine sells 14 bring-your-own RV sites by the night (10, 13-24, 36); the operator's directory listing and Florida Rambler count 36-37 sites in all. The unpriced units (4, 11, 31 and others) and the 'Seasonal Return RV Resident' lead source suggest the rest are seasonal residents. 14 of ~36 is well over 1 in 10, and no homes or lots are sold (the 2 houses and 1 apartment in the engine are rentals).
No minimum stay: the engine's minimum-nights rule is off and it priced single nights in January and March. Stays over 60 nights go by phone.
Winter is nearly sold out: on Tue Feb 9 2027 no bring-your-own site was free, on Jan 12 only 2 waterfront sites were.
Google 4.6/1,910 is mostly reviews of the restaurant and tiki bar. Florida Rambler calls the sites 'a tight fit' on a gravel lot. All sites are back-in only.
Phone: the RV office/booking engine is 305-296-3553; the contact page's 305-509-5693 is the restaurant/office line that Google shows.
Booking deep link (website holds one URL): https://bedg.booking.rentmanager.com/#/home?locationID=1&propertyID=230
Operator: Parakeet Communities LLC (a manufactured-housing and RV community operator); not a Sun, Thousand Trails or membership park.
